hook_title.fr: Accusée de tricher parce qu'elle est pauvre

loop_note: Partie 1, coupée quand Awa prend la craie devant tout le monde.

fr.title: Partie 1 : LA FILLE DU GARDIEN 📚
fr.description: Awa, la fille du gardien de nuit, finit première de l'école des riches. Une mère puissante l'accuse d'avoir triché, et son père perd son travail. Alors Awa demande l'impossible… Tu penses qu'elle va y arriver ? Voix et images générées par IA.

cast.name: Awa
cast.look: a 12-year-old West African girl, dark brown skin, neat long box braids tied with a yellow ribbon, big bright determined eyes, a clean but worn navy school uniform with a white collar, a mended school notebook
cast.voice: a clear determined voice of a twelve-year-old girl

cast.name: Papa Issa
cast.look: a 50-year-old West African night guard, dark brown skin, short grey beard, no glasses, gentle tired eyes, a dark green security guard uniform with a badge, a flashlight on his belt
cast.voice: a deep gentle voice of a loving father in his fifties

cast.name: Madame Kanté
cast.look: a wealthy 45-year-old West African woman, dark brown skin, no glasses, an elegant royal blue boubou dress with gold embroidery and a matching headwrap, heavy gold bracelets and necklace, proud disdainful face
cast.voice: a haughty cold female voice that commands

cast.name: Nadia
cast.look: a 12-year-old West African girl, dark brown skin, a high puff ponytail with a pink scrunchie, the same navy school uniform but brand new, a designer backpack, a proud jealous look

cast.name: Monsieur Diop
cast.look: a 55-year-old West African school principal, dark brown skin, round glasses, a beige suit and a patterned tie, nervous hands
cast.voice: a hesitant male voice in his fifties

cast.name: L'inspecteur
cast.look: a 60-year-old West African education inspector, dark brown skin, short white hair, a dark navy suit, a calm authoritative face
cast.voice: a calm authoritative deep male voice

scenes.visual_prompt: Awa, overjoyed, points at the first line of a results board with a posted list in the sunny courtyard of an elegant private school in West Africa, palm trees and white arches. Medium shot, warm morning light
scenes.motion_prompt: Awa jumps with joy and turns around, braids flying. Children chatting, birds.

lines.text: Ma fille… première, dans l'école des riches.

scenes.visual_prompt: Papa Issa, proud with shining eyes, holds a broom in the school courtyard while Awa runs to him. Medium shot, morning light
scenes.motion_prompt: He drops the broom and opens his arms, smiling through tears. Birds and courtyard noise.

lines.text: La fille du gardien, première ? Elle a triché.

scenes.visual_prompt: Nadia, jealous, crumples the results list in her fist in the school courtyard, other students behind her. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: She crumples the paper and narrows her eyes. Paper crumpling.

lines.text: Son père a les clés. Il lui a volé les sujets !

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Kanté, furious, slams her hand on the principal's wooden desk, gold bracelets jingling; Monsieur Diop sits behind the desk, nervous. Medium shot, window with palm trees
scenes.motion_prompt: Her hand hits the desk, the bracelets jingle, he flinches. Bracelets jingling, a slap on wood.

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Diop, uneasy, adjusts his round glasses behind his wooden desk in the principal's office, window with palm trees behind him. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He wipes his forehead with a handkerchief. Ceiling fan humming.

lines.text: Je paie votre nouvelle bibliothèque. Il vous faut une preuve ?

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Kanté, threatening, leans over the principal's wooden desk with a cold smile, in the principal's office. Low angle close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: She leans in slowly, eyes locked on him. Ceiling fan humming.

scenes.visual_prompt: Awa and Papa Issa stand small and silent in front of the principal's huge desk in a big office, Monsieur Diop behind it. Wide shot, high angle
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow push-in on the father and daughter holding hands. Silence, ceiling fan.

lines.text: Awa, ta note est annulée. Monsieur Traoré… vous êtes renvoyé.

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Diop, ashamed, avoids their eyes and signs a paper at his wooden desk in the principal's office. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He signs quickly without looking up. Pen scratching.

lines.text: Vingt ans de nuits… pour ça.

scenes.visual_prompt: Papa Issa, dignified, places his keys on the principal's desk, his hands trembling. Close-up on his hands and face
scenes.motion_prompt: The keys clink on the desk, he straightens his back. Keys clinking.

lines.text: Pardon, Papa. C'est à cause de moi.

scenes.visual_prompt: Awa, crying, walks home beside Papa Issa carrying a cardboard box of belongings, evening rain on a dusty street with modest houses and palm trees. Medium shot, cold blue light, warm streetlamp
scenes.motion_prompt: They walk slowly in the rain, she wipes her tears. Sound of rain.

lines.text: C'est à cause de ce que tu vaux. Ça leur fait peur.

scenes.visual_prompt: Papa Issa kneels in the rain and gently holds Awa's face with both hands, the cardboard box at their feet, both soaked, tender. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He wipes her tears with his thumbs and smiles, slow push-in. Sound of rain.

scenes.visual_prompt: Nadia receives the first prize certificate on the stage of a school prize ceremony under a big open-air hall; Madame Kanté applauds proudly in the front row, rich parents around. Wide shot, festive daylight
scenes.motion_prompt: Applause, Nadia raises the certificate, her mother claps. Applause.

scenes.visual_prompt: Awa, alone and brave, pushes open the doors of the ceremony hall, backpack on her shoulders, backlit. Low angle, wide shot
scenes.motion_prompt: The doors swing open, everyone turns, she steps forward. Doors banging, applause stops.

lines.text: Le même examen. Nadia et moi. Ici, devant tout le monde.

scenes.visual_prompt: Awa, determined, stands in the central aisle facing the stage, the whole audience turned toward her. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: She clenches her fists and lifts her chin, slow push-in. Murmurs.

scenes.visual_prompt: The inspector stands up slowly in the front row while Madame Kanté jumps up, furious. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: He rises calmly and nods, she opens her mouth in outrage. Crowd gasps.

scenes.visual_prompt: Two blackboards side by side on the stage: Awa picks up a piece of chalk with confidence, Nadia trembles holding hers; a big countdown screen shows 10:00. Wide shot
scenes.motion_prompt: Awa raises the chalk to the board, Nadia's hand shakes, the countdown starts. A ticking clock.
